analysts.as: Growth of open GenAI models and ecosystem

caveat: The June shutdown account comes from Anthropic's own statements; the GLM-5.3 figures are Anthropic's tests of a rival.

expert.text: By 2027 usage of small, task-specific models will be at least three times that of general-purpose LLMs.
AI sovereignty is now an operational imperative; use modular, interoperable platforms to reduce vendor lock-in.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Avoid single-vendor lock-in in AI contracts and ask how access can change by region or policy.
lens.ciso: Treat downloadable open models as potential exploit tools and set rules for their internal use.
lens.cto: Keep a tested fallback model for every critical workflow; access to a frontier model can stop overnight.
lens.eng: Route routine tasks to small or open models and benchmark them on your own data.

line: Frontier, open and small specialised models now compete. Access to the best can change overnight.
scope: Which models you use and your access to them. Not what they cost.
